'''Kruss Gaal''' was an operative working on [[Darkside (space station)|Darkside]], a repair station in the [[Cularin asteroid belt]]. He was also a member of [[The Cell]], a criminal faction wanting to oust and replace local [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Nirama]]. He wasn't very highly placed in the Cell, neither was the Darkside faction in the general Cell scheme.<ref name="MW">{{LivingForce|Between the Worlds: MidWorld}}</ref>

Gaal was one of the few remaining members of the Darkside contingent after a raid committed by [[Nirama]]'s forces in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. Other survivors included [[Ahlya]], [[Dor Balse]], [[Jarrilyn]], [[Jasper]] and [[Michael (Darkside)|Michael]]. At that point, they were trying to recruit new members, including local [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], [[Kaarl]] the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] and some newcomers, but the people in Darkside felt no respect for the local Cell. Shortly thereafter, they were captured by a group of spies working for Nirama.<ref name="MW" />

His implication in The Cell and subsequent capture were public knowledge less than one month later.<ref name="UW">{{LivingForce|Between the Worlds: UnderWorld}}</ref>
